name: openbb_economic_indicators
description:
One economic indicator series for a country through the OpenBB Platform (obb.economy.indicators).
Returns: {indicator, data: [records with date, symbol, country and value]} or {error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol (indicator code of the chosen provider; default UNRATE); country (default united_states); provider (OpenBB 4.6 accepts econdb or imf; the default fred is rejected by this command, so set it).
Codes for each provider: openbb_economy_available_indicators. FRED series directly: fred_custom_series. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"symbol": "CPI", "country": "united_states", "provider": "econdb"}

country.description: Country, lower case with underscores (e.g. united_states)
